body: “Of course. The hospital is much busier than the infirmary, and I still have to call in a specialist for cases I'm unfamiliar with. But at least I know when to step in myself and when to call someone who knows more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looked up and smiled. Her seriousness soon gave way to her usual relaxed expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So the main reason you left the girls' school was to finish studying medicine?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The main reason, yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like there was a secondary reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nothing but women.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You're a woman yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. Being a woman doesn't stop me from liking men. Almost everyone there was female, from students to teachers. Barely seeing any men all day made me want a change of scenery too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So you thought coming back to a hospital as a doctor would let you meet more men?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Exactly. And what happened?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She pointed out of the office door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This hospital's full of women too. Female doctors, female nurses, female patients… Did I change jobs, or just buildings?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's not too late to resign.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka looked Sakaguchi up and down, then gave a deliberately slow nod.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hmm… not for now. There's one more here now, isn't there?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Currently classed as a high-quality addition.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That sounds like a statistical report.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Occupational hazard.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her shoulders shook with laughter. It took a moment before she held the folder steady again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't really go back to study medicine just for the men, did you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course not. Medicine is the real work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She paused for half a second and winked at Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Men? Added value.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And how's Hoshimi's added value?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Not bad lately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only not bad?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You're quite greedy. One meal with me, and you already want a five-star review?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka glanced at the office clock and picked up her folder properly. Her leisurely air faded, and she was a doctor ready to move on to the next task again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do you talk like this to everyone in the hospital?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Depends on the person.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And what kind of person am I?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One date so far. Good-looking, reliable at work, and I enjoy talking to you. Worth keeping under observation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Such a cautious assessment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She raised the chart in her hand and lightly tapped the records on Sakaguchi's desk.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This is a hospital. Flirting is one thing, but if you miss something here, I'll still tell you off. Don't think I'll let you slack off at work just because you're fairly good-looking.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A moment ago I was a high-quality addition.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If your work isn't up to standard, even high quality can get downgraded. All right, my two minutes are already up.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She put the pen back in her pocket and headed for the door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nanjo, one more thing. You look good in scrubs too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She had been about to leave, but turned back at his words.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Scrubs? With the cap and the mask on, half my face covered, you can still tell?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka looked at him for two seconds, her eyes curving into a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. At least you've got good taste.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But next time we operate, remember to keep your eyes on the surgical field.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Can't I look at you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sneak a look if you can spare the attention. If you make a mistake, don't expect me to comfort you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She smiled, waved, and left the office. The door closed behind her. Sakaguchi set aside the documents he had just signed and picked up the chart he had yet to finish reading.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Two light knocks sounded at the office door. Sakaguchi looked up to find Sayaka standing there with a chart folder in her arms and a pen tucked into her white coat pocket.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Got a moment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Depends on what you're holding. I take it you're not here to ask when I'm free to go out?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Work. Don't worry, I'm not here to bother you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka set the chart on the desk and gave a little laugh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The way you emphasize that only makes it sound more suspicious.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then read the chart before you get suspicious. I've checked the medication history again. The records are consistent, and this value is fine too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She opened the records and pointed straight to the two places she had marked.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about the imaging?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We still need to confirm this afternoon's review. If nothing changes, we follow the original plan. If anything does, I'll come find you. No need to chase me all over the hospital.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You've already organized everything I was going to ask about.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I really am here to work. Here, just sign this.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi checked the details and signed. Sayaka took the chart back and clipped the relevant documents into place again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good, that's the business taken care of. I'll take this chart back with me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka didn't leave immediately. Holding the folder against her chest, she let out a soft breath and leaned against the desk.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Something else?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I've just been back and forth between the clinic and the ward several times. Can't I linger for two minutes? Let me catch my breath.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sure. As long as you don't hand me your entire afternoon's work while you're at it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “In your dreams. My own patients are still waiting for me. Just two minutes. That's more like it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She glanced down at the documents in her arms, pulled out an extra sheet that hadn't been filed yet, and held it out to Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh, put this one in for me. My hands are full.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You certainly know how to put people to work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi put the sheet in the right place in the chart folder. Sayaka checked it and gathered everything up.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good boy.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Who are you praising?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The person helping me. If you don't like it, I'll say something else next time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She spoke with a perfectly straight face, but her eyes were full of laughter.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You're acting pretty normal today, though. I thought you'd go all strictly professional when you saw me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “How should I act? Start discussing our next date in the hospital corridor?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Some men are smooth talkers on the weekend, then put their white coats back on Monday and pretend they don't know you. Of course the work has to get done. You don't have to act so stiff.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So bringing me the chart was also a chance to see whether I'd pretend not to know you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hey, I took care of the actual work first. As for the other part… you can work that out yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi glanced at her, his eyes lingering on her white coat without quite meaning to. Sayaka noticed immediately.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Looking again?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The white coat.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Didn't get enough of a look on your first day? Or has one meal together suddenly made you bolder?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We didn't know each other on the first day. We know each other a little better now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One meal together, and you're already brave enough to say that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do you mind?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Not at all. Look all you like, but move your eyes up a little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She tapped her face with a fingertip, then laughed as Sakaguchi raised his eyes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only noticing now? You were so well-behaved when we first met.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I didn't dare say it before. I thought you'd assume I was just staring at your clothes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh? You're getting braver rather quickly. That's fine. I don't mind a good compliment.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She arched her brows, clearly not about to stop teasing him over a single compliment.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “By the way, did you wear a white coat like this when you worked in the girls' school infirmary?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course not. If I'd gone to work looking like this, the parents would have come looking for me before the students did.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “More well-behaved back then?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little more than now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You have a lot to say, don't you? I was a perfectly respectable school nurse. The work wasn't much easier than it is now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She shifted into a more comfortable position against the desk, as though remembering a few things that had left her unsure whether to laugh or sigh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All sorts came to the infirmary. Girls who'd twisted an ankle in PE, girls white as a sheet from period cramps who still insisted they were fine, and girls faking stomachaches to get out of math.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You took in the ones who were faking it too?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I could tell by the third visit. But sometimes I'd still let her lie down for a while before going back to class.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You knew she wasn't ill, and you still let her rest?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sometimes it wasn't a stomachache. She just really didn't want to go back to class that day. If someone's come to the infirmary three times already, you should at least ask why she doesn't want to go back.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like you were busier than the classroom teachers.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We each had our own troubles. Anyway, once someone was in front of me, I'd look for what I could see and ask what I could find out.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She said it naturally, without trying to look as though she was teaching anyone a lesson.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Some were even harder to deal with. Girls coming in crying over a breakup, sobbing away. No fever, but their eyes were so red it was alarming.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The infirmary handled that too?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What else was I supposed to do, throw her out? Taking temperatures isn't all I can do.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She deliberately imitated a student's wounded tone.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “‘Miss, yesterday he said he loved me more than anyone. How come he's gone off with someone from the next class today?’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What did you tell her?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There are plenty of men.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi looked at her. Sayaka couldn't help laughing first.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course I didn't actually say that. I was still a very respectable teacher back then, you know.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And you're not respectable now?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka pointed at her white coat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Now I'm a very respectable doctor. After work is another matter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So you consider these two minutes part of work?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. You still have charts to read, and I'm not ready to let you escape yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her words sounded stern, but her face wore that familiar mischievous smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “From the way you talk about it, you really liked working in the infirmary. Why did you go back to finish studying medicine?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I did like it. Sometimes those students were more willing to tell the truth in the infirmary when something happened. After two years there, I was quite sorry to leave.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She fell quiet for a moment, turning the folder in her hands.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But there were a few times when I knew a nap through one class or a cup of hot water wasn't going to be enough. I did everything I could, but for proper examinations and treatment, I still had to send her

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: elsewhere.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't like just waiting for news?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I didn't like that feeling of ‘this is where it stops being my job.’ Contacting parents and calling an ambulance were part of my work, of course. But once she was taken away, all I could do was wait.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So I went back and finished the rest of my medical training. I wanted to do more myself, instead of always standing at the door waiting for someone else to tell me the result.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Now that there's more you can do yourself, feeling good about it?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. The hospital is much busier than the infirmary, and I still have to call in a specialist for cases I'm unfamiliar with. But at least I know when to step in myself and when to call someone who knows more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looked up and smiled. Her seriousness soon gave way to her usual relaxed expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So the main reason you left the girls' school was to finish studying medicine?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The main reason, yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like there was a secondary reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nothing but women.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You're a woman yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. Being a woman doesn't stop me from liking men. Almost everyone there was female, from students to teachers. Barely seeing any men all day made me want a change of scenery too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So you thought coming back to a hospital as a doctor would let you meet more men?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Exactly. And what happened?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She pointed out of the office door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This hospital's full of women too. Female doctors, female nurses, female patients… Did I change jobs, or just buildings?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's not too late to resign.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka looked Sakaguchi up and down, then gave a deliberately slow nod.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hmm… not for now. There's one more here now, isn't there?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Currently classed as a high-quality addition.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That sounds like a statistical report.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Occupational hazard.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her shoulders shook with laughter. It took a moment before she held the folder steady again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't really go back to study medicine just for the men, did you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course not. Medicine is the real work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She paused for half a second and winked at Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Men? Added value.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And how's Hoshimi's added value?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Not bad lately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only not bad?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You're quite greedy. One meal with me, and you already want a five-star review?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka glanced at the office clock and picked up her folder properly. Her leisurely air faded, and she was a doctor ready to move on to the next task again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do you talk like this to everyone in the hospital?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Depends on the person.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And what kind of person am I?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One date so far. Good-looking, reliable at work, and I enjoy talking to you. Worth keeping under observation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Such a cautious assessment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She raised the chart in her hand and lightly tapped the records on Sakaguchi's desk.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This is a hospital. Flirting is one thing, but if you miss something here, I'll still tell you off. Don't think I'll let you slack off at work just because you're fairly good-looking.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A moment ago I was a high-quality addition.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If your work isn't up to standard, even high quality can get downgraded. All right, my two minutes are already up.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She put the pen back in her pocket and headed for the door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nanjo, one more thing. You look good in scrubs too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She had been about to leave, but turned back at his words.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Scrubs? With the cap and the mask on, half my face covered, you can still tell?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka looked at him for two seconds, her eyes curving into a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. At least you've got good taste.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But next time we operate, remember to keep your eyes on the surgical field.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Can't I look at you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sneak a look if you can spare the attention. If you make a mistake, don't expect me to comfort you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She smiled, waved, and left the office. The door closed behind her. Sakaguchi set aside the documents he had just signed and picked up the chart he had yet to finish reading.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Two light knocks sounded at the office door. Sakaguchi looked up to find Sayaka standing there with a chart folder in her arms and a pen tucked into her white coat pocket.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Got a moment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Depends on what you're holding. I take it you're not here to ask when I'm free to go out?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Work. Don't worry, I'm not here to bother you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka set the chart on the desk and gave a little laugh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The way you emphasize that only makes it sound more suspicious.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then read the chart before you get suspicious. I've checked the medication history again. The records are consistent, and this value is fine too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She opened the records and pointed straight to the two places she had marked.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about the imaging?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We still need to confirm this afternoon's review. If nothing changes, we follow the original plan. If anything does, I'll come find you. No need to chase me all over the hospital.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You've already organized everything I was going to ask about.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I really am here to work. Here, just sign this.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi checked the details and signed. Sayaka took the chart back and clipped the relevant documents into place again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good, that's the business taken care of. I'll take this chart back with me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka didn't leave immediately. Holding the folder against her chest, she let out a soft breath and leaned against the desk.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Something else?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I've just been back and forth between the clinic and the ward several times. Can't I linger for two minutes? Let me catch my breath.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sure. As long as you don't hand me your entire afternoon's work while you're at it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “In your dreams. My own patients are still waiting for me. Just two minutes. That's more like it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She glanced down at the documents in her arms, pulled out an extra sheet that hadn't been filed yet, and held it out to Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh, put this one in for me. My hands are full.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You certainly know how to put people to work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi put the sheet in the right place in the chart folder. Sayaka checked it and gathered everything up.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good boy.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Who are you praising?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The person helping me. If you don't like it, I'll say something else next time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She spoke with a perfectly straight face, but her eyes were full of laughter.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You're acting pretty normal today, though. I thought you'd go all strictly professional when you saw me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “How should I act? Start discussing our next date in the hospital corridor?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Some men are smooth talkers on the weekend, then put their white coats back on Monday and pretend they don't know you. Of course the work has to get done. You don't have to act so stiff.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So bringing me the chart was also a chance to see whether I'd pretend not to know you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hey, I took care of the actual work first. As for the other part… you can work that out yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi glanced at her, his eyes lingering on her white coat without quite meaning to. Sayaka noticed immediately.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Looking again?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The white coat.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Didn't get enough of a look on your first day? Or has one meal together suddenly made you bolder?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We didn't know each other on the first day. We know each other a little better now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One meal together, and you're already brave enough to say that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do you mind?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Not at all. Look all you like, but move your eyes up a little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She tapped her face with a fingertip, then laughed as Sakaguchi raised his eyes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka had been smiling, but the word “really” caught her off guard for a moment.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What's gotten into you today? A moment ago you were a doctor carefully checking a chart. Now you're suddenly quite the charmer.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's the truth.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She briefly looked away. When she looked back, her smile had grown.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right, I'll take that. But don't think one nice line gets you out of writing up charts. I won't let you skip a single one that needs your signature.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “By the way, did you wear a white coat like this when you worked in the girls' school infirmary?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course not. If I'd gone to work looking like this, the parents would have come looking for me before the students did.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “More well-behaved back then?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little more than now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You have a lot to say, don't you? I was a perfectly respectable school nurse. The work wasn't much easier than it is now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She shifted into a more comfortable position against the desk, as though remembering a few things that had left her unsure whether to laugh or sigh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All sorts came to the infirmary. Girls who'd twisted an ankle in PE, girls white as a sheet from period cramps who still insisted they were fine, and girls faking stomachaches to get out of math.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You took in the ones who were faking it too?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I could tell by the third visit. But sometimes I'd still let her lie down for a while before going back to class.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You knew she wasn't ill, and you still let her rest?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sometimes it wasn't a stomachache. She just really didn't want to go back to class that day. If someone's come to the infirmary three times already, you should at least ask why she doesn't want to go back.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like you were busier than the classroom teachers.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We each had our own troubles. Anyway, once someone was in front of me, I'd look for what I could see and ask what I could find out.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She said it naturally, without trying to look as though she was teaching anyone a lesson.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Some were even harder to deal with. Girls coming in crying over a breakup, sobbing away. No fever, but their eyes were so red it was alarming.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The infirmary handled that too?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What else was I supposed to do, throw her out? Taking temperatures isn't all I can do.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She deliberately imitated a student's wounded tone.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “‘Miss, yesterday he said he loved me more than anyone. How come he's gone off with someone from the next class today?’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What did you tell her?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There are plenty of men.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi looked at her. Sayaka couldn't help laughing first.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course I didn't actually say that. I was still a very respectable teacher back then, you know.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And you're not respectable now?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka pointed at her white coat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Now I'm a very respectable doctor. After work is another matter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So you consider these two minutes part of work?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. You still have charts to read, and I'm not ready to let you escape yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her words sounded stern, but her face wore that familiar mischievous smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “From the way you talk about it, you really liked working in the infirmary. Why did you go back to finish studying medicine?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I did like it. Sometimes those students were more willing to tell the truth in the infirmary when something happened. After two years there, I was quite sorry to leave.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She fell quiet for a moment, turning the folder in her hands.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But there were a few times when I knew a nap through one class or a cup of hot water wasn't going to be enough. I did everything I could, but for proper examinations and treatment, I still had to send her

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: elsewhere.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't like just waiting for news?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I didn't like that feeling of ‘this is where it stops being my job.’ Contacting parents and calling an ambulance were part of my work, of course. But once she was taken away, all I could do was wait.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So I went back and finished the rest of my medical training. I wanted to do more myself, instead of always standing at the door waiting for someone else to tell me the result.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Now that there's more you can do yourself, feeling good about it?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. The hospital is much busier than the infirmary, and I still have to call in a specialist for cases I'm unfamiliar with. But at least I know when to step in myself and when to call someone who knows more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looked up and smiled. Her seriousness soon gave way to her usual relaxed expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So the main reason you left the girls' school was to finish studying medicine?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The main reason, yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like there was a secondary reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nothing but women.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You're a woman yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. Being a woman doesn't stop me from liking men. Almost everyone there was female, from students to teachers. Barely seeing any men all day made me want a change of scenery too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So you thought coming back to a hospital as a doctor would let you meet more men?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Exactly. And what happened?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She pointed out of the office door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This hospital's full of women too. Female doctors, female nurses, female patients… Did I change jobs, or just buildings?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's not too late to resign.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka looked Sakaguchi up and down, then gave a deliberately slow nod.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hmm… not for now. There's one more here now, isn't there?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Currently classed as a high-quality addition.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That sounds like a statistical report.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Occupational hazard.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her shoulders shook with laughter. It took a moment before she held the folder steady again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't really go back to study medicine just for the men, did you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course not. Medicine is the real work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She paused for half a second and winked at Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Men? Added value.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And how's Hoshimi's added value?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Not bad lately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only not bad?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You're quite greedy. One meal with me, and you already want a five-star review?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka glanced at the office clock and picked up her folder properly. Her leisurely air faded, and she was a doctor ready to move on to the next task again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do you talk like this to everyone in the hospital?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Depends on the person.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And what kind of person am I?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One date so far. Good-looking, reliable at work, and I enjoy talking to you. Worth keeping under observation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Such a cautious assessment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She raised the chart in her hand and lightly tapped the records on Sakaguchi's desk.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This is a hospital. Flirting is one thing, but if you miss something here, I'll still tell you off. Don't think I'll let you slack off at work just because you're fairly good-looking.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A moment ago I was a high-quality addition.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If your work isn't up to standard, even high quality can get downgraded. All right, my two minutes are already up.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She put the pen back in her pocket and headed for the door.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nanjo, one more thing. You look good in scrubs too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She had been about to leave, but turned back at his words.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Scrubs? With the cap and the mask on, half my face covered, you can still tell?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka looked at him for two seconds, her eyes curving into a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. At least you've got good taste.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But next time we operate, remember to keep your eyes on the surgical field.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Can't I look at you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sneak a look if you can spare the attention. If you make a mistake, don't expect me to comfort you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She smiled, waved, and left the office. The door closed behind her. Sakaguchi set aside the documents he had just signed and picked up the chart he had yet to finish reading.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Two light knocks sounded at the office door. Sakaguchi looked up to find Sayaka standing there with a chart folder in her arms and a pen tucked into her white coat pocket.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Got a moment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Depends on what you're holding. I take it you're not here to ask when I'm free to go out?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Work. Don't worry, I'm not here to bother you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka set the chart on the desk and gave a little laugh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The way you emphasize that only makes it sound more suspicious.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then read the chart before you get suspicious. I've checked the medication history again. The records are consistent, and this value is fine too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She opened the records and pointed straight to the two places she had marked.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about the imaging?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We still need to confirm this afternoon's review. If nothing changes, we follow the original plan. If anything does, I'll come find you. No need to chase me all over the hospital.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You've already organized everything I was going to ask about.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I really am here to work. Here, just sign this.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi checked the details and signed. Sayaka took the chart back and clipped the relevant documents into place again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good, that's the business taken care of. I'll take this chart back with me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka didn't leave immediately. Holding the folder against her chest, she let out a soft breath and leaned against the desk.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Something else?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I've just been back and forth between the clinic and the ward several times. Can't I linger for two minutes? Let me catch my breath.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sure. As long as you don't hand me your entire afternoon's work while you're at it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “In your dreams. My own patients are still waiting for me. Just two minutes. That's more like it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She glanced down at the documents in her arms, pulled out an extra sheet that hadn't been filed yet, and held it out to Sakaguchi.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh, put this one in for me. My hands are full.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You certainly know how to put people to work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi put the sheet in the right place in the chart folder. Sayaka checked it and gathered everything up.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good boy.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Who are you praising?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The person helping me. If you don't like it, I'll say something else next time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She spoke with a perfectly straight face, but her eyes were full of laughter.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You're acting pretty normal today, though. I thought you'd go all strictly professional when you saw me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “How should I act? Start discussing our next date in the hospital corridor?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Some men are smooth talkers on the weekend, then put their white coats back on Monday and pretend they don't know you. Of course the work has to get done. You don't have to act so stiff.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So bringing me the chart was also a chance to see whether I'd pretend not to know you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hey, I took care of the actual work first. As for the other part… you can work that out yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi glanced at her, his eyes lingering on her white coat without quite meaning to. Sayaka noticed immediately.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Looking again?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The white coat.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Didn't get enough of a look on your first day? Or has one meal together suddenly made you bolder?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We didn't know each other on the first day. We know each other a little better now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One meal together, and you're already brave enough to say that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do you mind?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Not at all. Look all you like, but move your eyes up a little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She tapped her face with a fingertip, then laughed as Sakaguchi raised his eyes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: This time Sayaka really did pause in surprise, apparently not expecting Sakaguchi to choose that outfit.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Scrubs? With the cap and the mask on, half my face covered, you can still tell?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She stared at Sakaguchi for two seconds, then her eyes finally curved into a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. At least you've got good taste.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “By the way, did you wear a white coat like this when you worked in the girls' school infirmary?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course not. If I'd gone to work looking like this, the parents would have come looking for me before the students did.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “More well-behaved back then?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little more than now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You have a lot to say, don't you? I was a perfectly respectable school nurse. The work wasn't much easier than it is now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She shifted into a more comfortable position against the desk, as though remembering a few things that had left her unsure whether to laugh or sigh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All sorts came to the infirmary. Girls who'd twisted an ankle in PE, girls white as a sheet from period cramps who still insisted they were fine, and girls faking stomachaches to get out of math.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You took in the ones who were faking it too?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I could tell by the third visit. But sometimes I'd still let her lie down for a while before going back to class.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You knew she wasn't ill, and you still let her rest?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sometimes it wasn't a stomachache. She just really didn't want to go back to class that day. If someone's come to the infirmary three times already, you should at least ask why she doesn't want to go back.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like you were busier than the classroom teachers.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We each had our own troubles. Anyway, once someone was in front of me, I'd look for what I could see and ask what I could find out.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She said it naturally, without trying to look as though she was teaching anyone a lesson.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Some were even harder to deal with. Girls coming in crying over a breakup, sobbing away. No fever, but their eyes were so red it was alarming.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The infirmary handled that too?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What else was I supposed to do, throw her out? Taking temperatures isn't all I can do.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She deliberately imitated a student's wounded tone.
