labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “‘Miss, yesterday he said he loved me more than anyone. How come he's gone off with someone from the next class today?’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What did you tell her?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There are plenty of men.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi looked at her. Sayaka couldn't help laughing first.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course I didn't actually say that. I was still a very respectable teacher back then, you know.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “And you're not respectable now?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka pointed at her white coat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Now I'm a very respectable doctor. After work is another matter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So you consider these two minutes part of work?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. You still have charts to read, and I'm not ready to let you escape yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her words sounded stern, but her face wore that familiar mischievous smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “From the way you talk about it, you really liked working in the infirmary. Why did you go back to finish studying medicine?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I did like it. Sometimes those students were more willing to tell the truth in the infirmary when something happened. After two years there, I was quite sorry to leave.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She fell quiet for a moment, turning the folder in her hands.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But there were a few times when I knew a nap through one class or a cup of hot water wasn't going to be enough. I did everything I could, but for proper examinations and treatment, I still had to send her

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: elsewhere.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You didn't like just waiting for news?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I didn't like that feeling of ‘this is where it stops being my job.’ Contacting parents and calling an ambulance were part of my work, of course. But once she was taken away, all I could do was wait.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So I went back and finished the rest of my medical training. I wanted to do more myself, instead of always standing at the door waiting for someone else to tell me the result.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Now that there's more you can do yourself, feeling good about it?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. The hospital is much busier than the infirmary, and I still have to call in a specialist for cases I'm unfamiliar with. But at least I know when to step in myself and when to call someone who knows more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looked up and smiled. Her seriousness soon gave way to her usual relaxed expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “When you put it that plainly, I really do feel like you’re evaluating me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m not evaluating you. I just want to look. You evaluate someone to decide whether you want them. I made that decision a long time ago.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If you’ve already decided, why are you still looking?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I like looking.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She says it as if it were the most natural thing in the world, then lowers her head to check that the chart folder is fastened. Something between them has shifted a little, but the work in their hands hasn’t stopped.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Work finally reaches a stopping point. Sakaguchi waits near the staff exit for a while before Sayaka comes out of the staff area, changed into her own clothes. When she notices his gaze resting on her, she pauses for

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: a moment.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What? Didn’t get enough of looking in the corridor today? Or don’t you recognize me now that I’ve changed?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I recognize you. But earlier you were clutching a chart folder and hurrying people along. You look a little different now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Work’s over. I can’t very well go out to dinner in my white coat. Besides, weren’t you rather enjoying looking just now?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What do you feel like eating today, then? I’ll find somewhere with you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka seems not to have expected Sakaguchi to take up the conversation so naturally. Then she smiles.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Anything simple is fine. Somewhere without too long a wait. I don’t feel like waiting for someone else to call my name again today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Let’s head out, then. There’s bound to be somewhere nearby where we can sit down.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sure. That sounds like someone who actually intends to spend time with me after work, instead of just saying it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: They walk out of the hospital side by side, leaving the corridor and the sounds of work farther and farther behind.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: They sit down in a small restaurant near the hospital. There are no special plans, no sense of an elaborate date. When the steaming food arrives, Sayaka finally sets her bag beside her, looking as though she has truly

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: let go of work a little.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You picked a nice place. We don’t have to study the menu forever, and we can sit down and enjoy a proper bite to eat. Coming out with you saves me worrying about where to go.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You’ve had enough to worry about at the hospital. After work, you can let me make a decision once in a while.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh, that was rather smooth. Are you learning how to sweet-talk me, or have you always been this good at looking after people?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I just thought you’ve been busy all day. At least don’t turn dinner into more work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka picks up the soup that has just arrived, but the heat makes her stop as soon as she tries it. Seeing this, Sakaguchi gestures for her to set it down for a moment.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Let it cool a little first. It just came out. It’s hot.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ah, I was just reminding a patient at the hospital not to rush to move around, and now I can’t even wait for a spoonful of soup. Have you caught me red-handed, Dr. Sakaguchi?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m not scolding you. I just don’t want you to burn yourself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka sets her spoon down again. This time, she doesn’t rush to follow up with a bolder joke. She simply smiles, quite naturally.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Mm, then I’ll listen to you. Having someone look after me like this feels pretty nice, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: They eat and chat about ordinary little things for a while. Hospital handovers, shifts, and patients are not problems they need to solve at this table. Sayaka makes the occasional joke, and Sakaguchi readily joins in.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The mood is more relaxed than on their first official date.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Honestly, I really like this. No special plans—just sitting down to a meal with you—and I don’t get bored.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me too. If you don’t want to go straight home today, we could walk a little farther.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sure. I don’t want to call it a night this early either. Of course I’m happy when you’re the one inviting me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Only then does she pick up her spoon, now that the soup is no longer too hot, with an easy smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: After leaving the little restaurant, they walk slowly along the street. Sayaka doesn’t immediately look for the shortest way home. Instead, she matches Sakaguchi’s pace as they pass another intersection.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Something just struck me as funny. At the hospital, calling you ‘Dr. Sakaguchi’ comes so naturally. But after work, when we’re eating and walking together, using it all the time feels like something’s missing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You want to call me something else?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It’s not just what I call you. We both know how we feel, but if someone asks, I’d still have to say, ‘We’re just ordinary colleagues who eat together now and then.’ It sounds ridiculous even to me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What would you like to say, then?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka stops and turns to face Sakaguchi. Her expression doesn’t become anxious or sad, just a little more serious than before.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’ve had my answer for a long time. But this time, I want to hear you say yours. If you want a relationship, let’s do it properly. We don’t need to keep talking in circles.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So what exactly are we now?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka visibly pauses for half a beat. She looks as though she had a joke ready, only for Sakaguchi’s answer to get there first.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You’re bold today. I thought you’d have to talk your way around it a couple of times, but you were even more direct than me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Don’t like it?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No. I like it quite a lot. Now that you’ve put it that way, I can say yes with every right to mean it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Even though their relationship is settled, neither of them moves on just yet. Sayaka glances at Sakaguchi, without taking back what she just said as a joke.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right. Now that we’ve made it clear, you don’t get to pretend you never gave that answer.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I wasn’t planning to take it back.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: They stand quietly beneath a streetlamp for a while. Sakaguchi doesn’t start walking right away, and Sayaka doesn’t hurry him. She looks up at him, her eyes still holding a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What? Now that you’ve officially called me your girlfriend, all you can do is stand there looking at me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I was thinking there might be one thing I still haven’t done.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only just remembered? You’re not usually this slow at work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi moves closer. Sayaka doesn’t pull away; instead, she lifts her face slightly. He lowers his head and kisses her, and she naturally returns the kiss. After they part, she doesn’t immediately follow it with

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: a joke as she usually would.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka lets out a soft breath, briefly looks away, then can’t help smiling again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You were certainly quick about that. I was just thinking of something to say, and suddenly I forgot my lines.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It’s rare to see you at a loss for words.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Don’t get too pleased with yourself. I thought it was nice, so I wasn’t in a hurry to tease you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: As she speaks, she takes half a step closer to Sakaguchi. Unlike before, there is no longer any need to explain the distance between them.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Well then, boyfriend. Walk me home today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Already ordering me around?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Can’t I? I’m not asking you to work my shift. I just want you to walk with me a little longer.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sure.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Let’s go, then.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka walks beside Sakaguchi. As they cross the road, the backs of their hands brush together, and she doesn’t move away. Neither makes a point of mentioning the word ‘girlfriend’ again along the way, yet they are

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: already acting on that answer quite naturally.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At the intersection where they are about to part, Sayaka stops and turns back.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “See you at the hospital tomorrow.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Mm-hm. But don’t keep staring at me at work tomorrow.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Weren’t you the one who kept looking at me first?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m allowed to look at you. You’re not allowed to look at me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She deliberately puts on a stern face, but can’t hold it for even two seconds before she laughs.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What kind of rule is that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Mine. I’m kidding—look all you want. Just don’t miss anything in the chart you’re holding.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sayaka waves to Sakaguchi, turns, and leaves. He watches her walk away. Only now does this day truly come to an end.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: all in the handover.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “...Is it that strict?”

Sakaguchi turns around.

The woman before him is tall and slender, with black hair. Her clothes are neat and practical, and the badge on her chest identifies her nursing management role. She carries two different

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Ryuji Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “This is the operating room schedule.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: She points to the other sheet.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “This is the nursing staff allocation schedule.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “You were looking at the first one.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I haven't checked the second one, that's true.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then don't say it can already be scheduled.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “So all that's free here is the room.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Correct.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Nurses don't automatically materialize in operating rooms.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What if we made a last-minute adjustment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I only wanted the patient to wait one day less.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I accept that reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “But saving the patient a day's wait cannot mean giving a nurse an extra shift.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I didn't mean to make them work overtime.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “A-ask you... directly?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Satsuki, didn't you know?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…D-Dr. Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nurse Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “W-Why are you in gynecology…?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “I called him. It’s new.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “And the leg supports.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “So… who is the live subject?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Lie down for us.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh. Dr. Sakaguchi will not affect the angle of the leg supports.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The leg-support angle is not the problem!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi takes two steps back on his own.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will stand here. If that is still uncomfortable, I can leave.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki exhales slowly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…This is only a test, right? No surprise examination?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You promise, Chief?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why would I lie about that?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because it is you…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “I heard that.”

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is about right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Then the supports are fine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “W-Wait!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua stops immediately.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Did it pinch you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “No!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Then what is wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s expression shifts from alarm to thought.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course the chair moves.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. But when you are lying here… you do not know when it will move.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua pauses and writes on her clipboard.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Warn the patient before a position change.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: Satsuki lifts her head slightly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Here?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I cannot see you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. This is where I stand for the examination.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is exactly why it is frightening.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When a nurse is standing, it feels as though the doctor is right beside the patient. Once you lie down, all you can see is the light.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You hear footsteps, drawers, and instruments… but you do not know what anyone is about to do.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: Aqua stands at the foot and Sakaguchi at the side. The patient is quickly surrounded, and Satsuki visibly tenses.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What is wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…It feels crowded.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There are only two of us.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It feels like only two when you are standing. It does not when you are lying down.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Is it uncomfortable?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m fi—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki stops, surprised by herself.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…See? I almost said, ‘I’m fine.’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Patients do this too. Especially once they are positioned and everyone is waiting.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “She may feel… that saying she is uncomfortable would inconvenience everyone.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So we cannot simply ask, ‘Are you okay?’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Right. It is better to ask something specific.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Are the supports pressing anywhere? Is there a gap under the lower back? Are you cold?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Or tell her directly that if anything is uncomfortable, we can readjust it now.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Aqua returns to the examination position with an impeccably professional expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa, relax.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki becomes even more rigid.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You did not relax.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because all you said was ‘relax’!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I told you to relax, so relax.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I cannot!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Dr. Sakaguchi, please do not laugh…”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I was not laughing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You were!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then what should I say?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “First, tell the patient what will happen next.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her voice softens into her nursing tone.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Next, the chair will recline a little farther and the leg supports will rise.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It may be a little uncomfortable. If it hurts or frightens you, tell me immediately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You do not have to endure it. We can stop at any time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The room falls quiet. Aqua writes. Satsuki is still in an embarrassing position, but she no longer avoids Sakaguchi’s gaze.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If we could change only one thing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One thing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “I understand.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…D-Dr. Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nurse Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “W-Why are you in gynecology…?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is about right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Here?”

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I cannot see you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course. This is where I stand for the examination.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is exactly why it is frightening.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “What is wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There are only two of us.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It feels like only two when you are standing. It does not when you are lying down.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Is it uncomfortable?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m fi—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki stops, surprised by herself.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…See? I almost said, ‘I’m fine.’”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Patients do this too. Especially once they are positioned and everyone is waiting.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: Aqua returns to the examination position with an impeccably professional expression.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “The gurney is not stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “…The patient is stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “…Really?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Really.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know I already consented. I know the operation is today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Back in the ward, I still thought I was fine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But when the door opened, when I saw that light, suddenly it felt—”

body: Her feet press harder against the frame.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Like I was really being pushed inside.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is quiet for several seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What does ‘yes’ mean?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We see this doorway every day, so we forget what it looks like.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “You do not have to put your feet down immediately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient visibly freezes in surprise.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “First, I will tell you what will happen after we enter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “After we enter, the gurney will first stop beside the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We will confirm your name, procedure, and wristband once more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Will you leave?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Why are you not pushing?”

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then... when does the defense come down?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Give me three more seconds.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right.”

body: One second.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Yes!”

H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then you are very well suited to this work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “…What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Your eyes are different when you talk about Sugimura than when you talk about other nurses.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki blushes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Senior Hiroko really is remarkable. When a patient is afraid, she knows when to speak.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When the doctors are busy, she knows when not to interrupt. She does not panic when something goes wrong.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I used to think… I wanted to become that kind of nurse too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then you went into gynecology.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s shoulders draw inward.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because… there were too many male doctors in surgery.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do not accept that so calmly! It makes it sound even more embarrassing!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is your reason. I have no right to be ashamed of it for you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki falls quiet.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But lately I have been thinking… if every time I become nervous, I choose to avoid that place—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I will never know whether I could actually do the work well.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks at the application.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Come with me once.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Where?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “To Head Nurse Ishigami.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: NURSING ADMINISTRATION OFFICE

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami sits behind her desk. Artoria is only accompanying Satsuki; she does not speak for her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You want to apply for a perioperative rotation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Y-Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her prepared answer catches in her throat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I want to become a better nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is an answer, not a reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I used to want to work in surgery. Later, because of my own problem, I went into gynecology.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I like my work now. But I realized I never truly let go of that wish.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami looks toward Artoria.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Did you bring her here to vouch for her?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “She asked me to accompany her. The application is hers.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami looks back at Satsuki.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Approved.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You will begin with the basics: holding, patient transport, and preoperative handoff.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You will not take an instrument role yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa. Do not pretend you understand something because you are nervous.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ask when you do not know. Say so when you cannot do something.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A problem affecting a patient matters far more than your embarrassment.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki nods slowly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I understand.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then go do it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: SEVERAL DAYS LATER — OR HOLDING

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is here for the first time as a rotation nurse. She still wears her black-framed glasses and adjusts them more often than usual, but her work remains orderly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: First patient: identity check, transport, handoff—complete.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Second patient: just as smooth. No incident, only one real task completed after another.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The third patient is an adult woman, Yoriko Nikaido. Her hair is under a surgical cap, and her gown and sheet cover her body. She is trying hard to appear calmer than she feels.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will confirm once more. Please tell me your name.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yoriko Nikaido.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Today’s procedure is a laparoscopic cholecystectomy.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Any medication allergies?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “None.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki completes the check. The patient speaks.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Miss Nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do I look extremely nervous?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki does not deny it reflexively.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…A little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You really said it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m usually the one telling everyone else not to be nervous... It doesn’t seem to work very well today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I-I’m sorry!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient cannot help smiling.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is fine. Better than lying that you cannot tell at all.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki relaxes a little too.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will take you inside. I will stay until the handoff is complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: OPERATING-ROOM CORRIDOR

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki pushes the gurney along the corridor. Sakaguchi approaches from the changing area, headed for the same operating room.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s shoulders visibly tense.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “D-Dr. Sakaguchi!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient looks up at her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The surgeon?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient studies her for two seconds, then lies back down.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I suddenly feel more nervous.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why did seeing the doctor make you more nervous…?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The automatic door opens. The room is brighter than the corridor; the patient sees the surgical lights, table, anesthesia machine, and waiting staff all at once.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient’s expression changes instantly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Wait.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki does not hear her clearly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The bed moves forward another little bit.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Wait, wait—I heard that once you go in, everyone just focuses on prep and the patient can’t find a chance to say anything—is that true?!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: THUD.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The entire gurney stops abruptly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks down at the wheels and tries a little more pressure. The gurney does not move at all.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Stop pushing—!!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki immediately releases the pressure. Sakaguchi looks toward the front from the side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: SIDE VIEW OF THE DOORWAY

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient has half sat up. Her legs spread to either side, each foot braced against one side of the entrance. The gurney is halfway through, but she has barred herself in place like a human door bolt.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The gurney is not stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks at the wheels, then at the patient.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…The patient is stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can hear you!!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The scene pauses for one beat. None of the staff laugh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki instinctively reaches to pull the gurney back, then stops. She does not touch the patient’s legs. Instead, she moves to where the patient can see her directly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right. We will not go in yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Really?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Really.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Everyone behind them stops. No one continues pushing. The patient takes several breaths.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know I already consented. I know the operation is today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Back in the ward, I still thought I was fine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks into the operating room.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But when the door opened, when I saw that light, suddenly it felt—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her feet press harder against the frame.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Like I was really being pushed inside.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is quiet for several seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What does ‘yes’ mean?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It means… I think what you feel is normal.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We see this doorway every day, so we forget what it looks like.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But today is the first time you have entered through it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You do not have to put your feet down immediately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient visibly freezes in surprise.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “First, I will tell you what will happen after we enter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “After we enter, the gurney will first stop beside the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We will confirm your name, procedure, and wristband once more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only after that will we help you move onto the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Anesthesia will not suddenly begin the moment we enter, and no one will move you without explaining.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Will you leave?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will not leave before the handoff is complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: After several seconds, the patient slowly lowers her left foot from the frame. Satsuki still does not move the gurney.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Why are you not pushing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There is still one more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient looks at the right foot still braced against the other side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...This foot is insurance. You always keep one line of defense.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi turns his face slightly away. He is not mocking her; he is holding back a small smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then... when does the defense come down?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Give me three more seconds.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: One second.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Two seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Three seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At last, the right foot slowly comes back inside.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You cannot push suddenly.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will not.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki returns to the foot of the gurney and applies only the slightest pressure. It crosses the threshold. The patient does not brace her feet again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: OPERATING ROOM — FORMAL HANDOFF

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The gurney stops beside the operating table. Hiroko receives them. Satsuki is still slightly tense when she begins, but her information is complete.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Adult female, Yoriko Nikaido. Wristband confirmed.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Scheduled today for laparoscopic cholecystectomy. No known medication allergies. Preoperative preparation complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
