Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I am only deciding… whether I should really submit it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A perioperative nursing rotation?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I used to want very much to become an operating-room nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…You know?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Your eyes are different when you talk about Sugimura than when you talk about other nurses.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki blushes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Senior Hiroko really is remarkable. When a patient is afraid, she knows when to speak.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “When the doctors are busy, she knows when not to interrupt. She does not panic when something goes wrong.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I used to think… I wanted to become that kind of nurse too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then you went into gynecology.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s shoulders draw inward.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because… there were too many male doctors in surgery.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do not accept that so calmly! It makes it sound even more embarrassing!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is your reason. I have no right to be ashamed of it for you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki falls quiet.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But lately I have been thinking… if every time I become nervous, I choose to avoid that place—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I will never know whether I could actually do the work well.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks at the application.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Come with me once.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Where?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “To Head Nurse Ishigami.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: NURSING ADMINISTRATION OFFICE

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami sits behind her desk. Artoria is only accompanying Satsuki; she does not speak for her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You want to apply for a perioperative rotation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Y-Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her prepared answer catches in her throat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Because I want to become a better nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That is an answer, not a reason.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I used to want to work in surgery. Later, because of my own problem, I went into gynecology.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I like my work now. But I realized I never truly let go of that wish.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami looks toward Artoria.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Did you bring her here to vouch for her?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “No.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “She asked me to accompany her. The application is hers.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami looks back at Satsuki.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Approved.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You will begin with the basics: holding, patient transport, and preoperative handoff.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You will not take an instrument role yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa. Do not pretend you understand something because you are nervous.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ask when you do not know. Say so when you cannot do something.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A problem affecting a patient matters far more than your embarrassment.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki nods slowly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I understand.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then go do it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: SEVERAL DAYS LATER — OR HOLDING

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is here for the first time as a rotation nurse. She still wears her black-framed glasses and adjusts them more often than usual, but her work remains orderly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: First patient: identity check, transport, handoff—complete.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Second patient: just as smooth. No incident, only one real task completed after another.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The third patient is an adult woman, Yoriko Nikaido. Her hair is under a surgical cap, and her gown and sheet cover her body. She is trying hard to appear calmer than she feels.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will confirm once more. Please tell me your name.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yoriko Nikaido.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Today’s procedure is a laparoscopic cholecystectomy.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Any medication allergies?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “None.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki completes the check. The patient speaks.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Miss Nurse.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Do I look extremely nervous?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki does not deny it reflexively.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…A little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You really said it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I’m usually the one telling everyone else not to be nervous... It doesn’t seem to work very well today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I-I’m sorry!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient cannot help smiling.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It is fine. Better than lying that you cannot tell at all.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki relaxes a little too.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will take you inside. I will stay until the handoff is complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: OPERATING-ROOM CORRIDOR

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki pushes the gurney along the corridor. Sakaguchi approaches from the changing area, headed for the same operating room.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Orikawa.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki’s shoulders visibly tense.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “D-Dr. Sakaguchi!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient looks up at her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The surgeon?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient studies her for two seconds, then lies back down.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…I suddenly feel more nervous.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Why did seeing the doctor make you more nervous…?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The automatic door opens. The room is brighter than the corridor; the patient sees the surgical lights, table, anesthesia machine, and waiting staff all at once.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient’s expression changes instantly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Wait.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki does not hear her clearly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The bed moves forward another little bit.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Wait, wait—I heard that once you go in, everyone just focuses on prep and the patient can’t find a chance to say anything—is that true?!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: THUD.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The entire gurney stops abruptly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks down at the wheels and tries a little more pressure. The gurney does not move at all.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Stop pushing—!!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki immediately releases the pressure. Sakaguchi looks toward the front from the side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: SIDE VIEW OF THE DOORWAY

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient has half sat up. Her legs spread to either side, each foot braced against one side of the entrance. The gurney is halfway through, but she has barred herself in place like a human door bolt.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The gurney is not stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki looks at the wheels, then at the patient.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…The patient is stuck.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can hear you!!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The scene pauses for one beat. None of the staff laugh.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki instinctively reaches to pull the gurney back, then stops. She does not touch the patient’s legs. Instead, she moves to where the patient can see her directly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right. We will not go in yet.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Really?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Really.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Everyone behind them stops. No one continues pushing. The patient takes several breaths.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know I already consented. I know the operation is today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Back in the ward, I still thought I was fine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks into the operating room.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But when the door opened, when I saw that light, suddenly it felt—”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her feet press harder against the frame.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Like I was really being pushed inside.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki is quiet for several seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…What does ‘yes’ mean?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It means… I think what you feel is normal.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We see this doorway every day, so we forget what it looks like.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “But today is the first time you have entered through it.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You do not have to put your feet down immediately.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient visibly freezes in surprise.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “First, I will tell you what will happen after we enter.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Okay.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “After we enter, the gurney will first stop beside the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “We will confirm your name, procedure, and wristband once more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Only after that will we help you move onto the operating table.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Anesthesia will not suddenly begin the moment we enter, and no one will move you without explaining.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What about you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Me?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Will you leave?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will not leave before the handoff is complete.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: After several seconds, the patient slowly lowers her left foot from the frame. Satsuki still does not move the gurney.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “…Why are you not pushing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There is still one more.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The patient looks at the right foot still braced against the other side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...This foot is insurance. You always keep one line of defense.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi turns his face slightly away. He is not mocking her; he is holding back a small smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then... when does the defense come down?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Give me three more seconds.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “All right.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: One second.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Two seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Three seconds.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At last, the right foot slowly comes back inside.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You cannot push suddenly.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I will not.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Satsuki returns to the foot of the gurney and applies only the slightest pressure. It crosses the threshold. The patient does not brace her feet again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Oh, that's some information I put together myself.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Staff nurses' pay, benefits, and comparisons with other hospitals...?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes! I spent ages researching it. Since I'm going to be an intern, I thought I should find out whether I might be able to stay afterward.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami looks at her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I have no objection to your researching pay and benefits. But this doesn't belong among the ward handover documents.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I-I'm sorry! I put it in the wrong place when I was sorting everything!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She quickly takes the sheet back and slips it into her notebook. The handwriting and tables on it are clearly very neat.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Just then, Ryuji Sakaguchi enters the nurses' station.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Dr. Sakaguchi, perfect timing. Let me introduce an intern who is starting today.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The girl immediately turns toward Sakaguchi and bows carefully.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's nice to meet you! I'm Megumi Kariya, and I'm starting my internship here today. I look forward to working with you!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, Kariya. You're certainly full of energy for your first day.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Of course! I've really been looking forward to this internship.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The internship begins on June first and lasts six months. The final assessment will be on December first. The nursing department will arrange your duties. Start by learning the daily routines in each department.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes! I've already read all the instructions you sent me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko Sugimura, who is sorting patient records nearby, looks up at her with a smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I hear you're keen to work at our hospital after you graduate?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'd like to stay after graduation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You've already decided?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. I've compared the offers, and the pay and benefits here are the best.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She pauses, then hastily adds something.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I mean, there's so much I can learn here!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There's nothing wrong with what you said the first time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Huh?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's perfectly normal to want to earn money through your own work.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Megumi visibly relaxes.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That's a relief. I was worried that saying that on my first day would give everyone a bad impression of me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “My family needs the money, and I want to become independent sooner, too. If I'm going to study hard and work hard during my internship, of course I want a well-paying job afterward.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Sounds like you've really done your homework.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes! I'm confident about that part.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then let's see how much homework you've done on nursing.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The phone at the nurses' station rings. Hiroko is busy checking the handover documents. Megumi instinctively reaches for it, then stops and looks at Ishigami.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “May I answer it?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ishigami nods.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Listen carefully to what the caller needs first. If you're unsure about something, leave the answer to the person responsible.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Megumi picks up the phone. Her slightly embarrassed expression immediately turns serious.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, you've reached the nurses' station. This is Kariya speaking.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...All right. Take your time. I'll write it down.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She opens her notebook and takes notes on a blank page, nodding gently as she listens.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “You'd like to confirm the time of your preoperative tests, is that right?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'm not able to answer that myself yet. May I check with the nurse in charge and have her get back to you?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: The person on the other end says a little more.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, I understand you're worried. I'll make sure your question is passed on clearly. Please hold.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She puts down the phone and hands her notes to Hiroko.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ms. Sugimura, this patient wants to confirm her preoperative test schedule. I've written down her name, ward, and question, but I don't know the exact time, so I couldn't just give her an answer.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko takes the paper and glances over it.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Thank you. These are very clear notes. I'll contact the nurse responsible.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Great! I'll take notes like this next time, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “One more thing, Kariya.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's good that you took the initiative to check what you didn't know on the phone. But you don't need to rush to do everyone's work on your very first day.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh... am I getting ahead of myself?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “A little.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Understood. I'll be more careful.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She quickly adds a line to her notebook.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko sets a rotation schedule in front of her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “During your internship, you'll experience the work of different departments. You'll gradually learn the nursing routines on the wards, in outpatients, and in the operating room.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The wards, outpatients...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At the words “operating room,” her pen suddenly stops.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I have to go to the operating room, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What's wrong? Don't you like operating rooms?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's not that I don't like them. It's just... I've never actually stood beside someone having an operation.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I can look at all the pictures at school. But when I see it for real... I don't know how I'll react.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She tries to keep smiling, but her fingers unconsciously tighten around the edge of her notebook.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If I don't do well then, will it affect my internship assessment?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Your assessment is based on how you learn and work over these six months. It won't be decided by your first attempt alone.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If you really feel unwell, tell a senior nurse right away. Pushing yourself until you can't even look after yourself won't help the patient.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...All right. I'll remember that.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks down, writes another line, then raises her head again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I'll keep studying ahead! I spent ages memorizing the operating room preparation procedure yesterday. I can't let that go to waste.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Being prepared is good. But once you're actually there, you also need to judge how you're coping.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, Dr. Sakaguchi.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Just then, Ange Tonegawa enters the nurses' station carrying a neatly sorted stack of patient records.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ms. Ishigami, the ward records are all sorted. Is there anything else I can help with?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Good timing. Ange, show Kariya, who is starting today, the routes around the wards and the nurses' station.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ange turns to Megumi with a friendly smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hello, I'm Ange Tonegawa. If there's anything you're unsure about, you can ask me.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hi! I'm Megumi Kariya. You look about my age.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, I'm eighteen.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Really? I'm eighteen, too!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She suddenly notices Ange's permanent nurse's name badge.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Oh, you're already a staff nurse?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes, but I still have plenty to learn.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I see...”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She looks at Ange's badge for a moment, then smiles.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then I'll have to work hard to catch up with you. In six months, I want to wear a badge like that, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then let's both do our best. Come with me and learn your way around the wards first.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Okay!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Megumi gathers her notebook and follows Ange toward the nurses' station exit. After a couple of steps, she turns back and bows earnestly to Sakaguchi, Hiroko, and Ishigami.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I'm really looking forward to working with all of you, starting today!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Welcome to Hoshimi Hospital.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “There's no need to rush. Learn one thing at a time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “I know. But... I've already done the math.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The math for what?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “If I can stay here, life will be a lot easier financially for both me and my family. I'm going to work hard for these six months to make that happen.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She speaks with complete sincerity, then returns to her cheerful smile.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Well then, I'd better get to work!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Ange waits for her by the door. The two leave the nurses' station side by side.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Once outside, Megumi quietly glances through the rotation schedule.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Ange... do you see blood very often in the operating room?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. Of course you'll see blood in an operating room.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...I thought so.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She falls silent for a moment, then closes her notebook.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “It's all right. I'll focus on learning what I can today!”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She quickens her steps to catch up with Ange. Back in the nurses' station, the phone rings again amid the day's work.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: At the nurses' station, Hiroko is briefing an unfamiliar nurse. The woman neatly puts several handover sheets into a folder, then looks up at Sakaguchi as she hears footsteps.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Doctor, perfect timing. Let me introduce someone.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “This is Saeko Hikami. She's just transferred here and will be working in internal medicine.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Saeko Hikami. I look forward to working with you.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: She bows slightly, her voice steady. Rather than nervous, she seems to have already prepared everything she needs to say on her first day.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Have you started the handover already?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Yes. Ms. Sugimura is showing me the wards and the duty schedule.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “The paperwork is all done. We can teach her the rest as she works.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Sakaguchi nods, then glances at Saeko again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hikami... I heard you had another reason for coming here?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That's what my character profile says.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Nothing. Please go on.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Her expression does not change. Sakaguchi looks at Hiroko, who lowers her eyes and turns a page of the duty roster.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Anyway, get used to the work first. We can talk about your situation later.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Please don't say later.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: This time, her answer comes quickly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “What's wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “That's how I waited last time, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Last time?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “They said I had an ulterior motive, a mysterious background, and probably a story coming later.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then the series got axed, the setup never paid off, and all I could do was go play mahjong.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction
H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “So, could you put my story on the schedule first this time?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: Hiroko pulls out a sheet of paper and hands it to her.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “I've put you on tomorrow's early shift first.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...At least I'm working as a nurse this time.”

body: “Have you started the handover already?”

body: Sakaguchi nods, then glances at Saeko again.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Hikami... I heard you had another reason for coming here?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “That's what my character profile says.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “...What?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Nothing. Please go on.”

body: “Anyway, get used to the work first. We can talk about your situation later.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Please don't say later.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: This time, her answer comes quickly.

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “What's wrong?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “That's how I waited last time, too.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Last time?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “They said I had an ulterior motive, a mysterious background, and probably a story coming later.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Then the series got axed, the setup never paid off, and all I could do was go play mahjong.”

H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “So, could you put my story on the schedule first this time?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “I've put you on tomorrow's early shift first.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “...At least I'm working as a nurse this time.”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “Come to think of it, don't postoperative scans at Hoshimi often look a little too perfect?”

body: “And then?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital
Development Prototype 0.5   /   Placeholder art · Not medical instruction

body: “Isn't that a good thing?”

labels.text: H O S H I M I   /   Hoshimi Hospital

body: “For the medical outcome, very good. For the radiologist's mental health, it's harder to say.”
